source.title: The Perfect Metal
source.description: Now that we've got the materials, I need a bit of time to try a few different combinations and test my results. This is delicate work, and I wouldn't want to waste any of the materials that you so graciously brought me by testing too hastily.
source.completion:
I'll be fine here on my own. In the meantime, start thinking about what kind of weapon you want made. If you find yourself suddenly inspired, feel free to return here and let me know.

Oh, and thank you, <name>. As much as I hate to admit it, having something like this to dig into has done me a lot of good. I'm still not sure if I'll ever rejoin the Argent Dawn, but at least I'm not moping around in that cage anymore.

Oh, and take this. It isn't much but its a token of my appreciation.
